_comment: Host-side whitelist of secrets a task/cron may request via its `secrets: ["NAME"]` field. Copy to injectable-secrets.json (gitignored). A NAME absent here is a hard spawn error (fail closed). Values are resolved from the mapped source at spawn time and injected as env vars into that session only; only names are audited (data/secret-injections.jsonl). Harness-managed keys (ANTHROPIC_*, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, MAX_THINKING_TOKENS, AGENTLAIR_AAT) can never be injected.
